symptoms.storage_claim_pending: A volume claim is not bound.

facts.pvc_lost: Claim {pvc} is in phase {phase}: the volume it was bound to no longer exists.
facts.pvc_missing: A Pod mounts claim {pvc}, but the claim does not exist.
facts.storage_class_missing: Claim {pvc} asks for StorageClass {class}, which does not exist.
facts.storage_default_class_missing: Claim {pvc} names no StorageClass, and the cluster has no default one.

hypotheses.pvc_missing: Claim {pvc} does not exist, so Pods that mount it cannot start.
hypotheses.pvc_lost: The volume behind claim {pvc} is gone, so the claim is Lost.
hypotheses.pvc_unbound: Claim {pvc} is not bound to a volume, and no more specific cause was found.
hypotheses.storage_class_not_found: Claim {pvc} asks for StorageClass {class}, which does not exist, so no volume can be provisioned.
hypotheses.storage_no_default_class: Claim {pvc} names no StorageClass and the cluster has no default one, so no volume is provisioned.
hypotheses.storage_waiting_first_consumer: Claim {pvc} binds only when a Pod uses it, and no Pod does.
hypotheses.storage_provisioning_failed: The volume provisioner failed to create a volume for claim {pvc}.

recommendations.rec_create_missing_claim: Create PersistentVolumeClaim {pvc}, or correct the claim name in the Pod spec.
recommendations.rec_restore_volume: Recover or recreate the volume that claim {pvc} was bound to, or create a new claim.
recommendations.rec_fix_storage_class: Create StorageClass {class}, or point claim {pvc} to an existing one.
recommendations.rec_set_default_storage_class: Mark a StorageClass as the default, or name one in claim {pvc}.
recommendations.rec_use_or_delete_claim: Start a Pod that uses claim {pvc}, or delete the claim if it is no longer needed.

steps.step_check_provisioner: Check the volume provisioner's logs and the events of claim {pvc}.

missing.service_selector_missing: The Service has no selector, so it does not choose any Pods.
missing.graph_unavailable: The dependency graph could not be built ({reason}).

graphReasons.oom_killed: Killed for running out of memory
